mustFix.title: The subject asserts g08 leftover-join.v4 remains the current G08 GATE leftover-join. It is not, and the subject says so in four other places.
mustFix.quotedBytes: g08 leftover-join.v4 (D-259) remains the current G08 GATE leftover-join and also measures OBL-G08-FX-AUTHORING leftoverDesign true.
mustFix.why: D-281 ('## D-281 — Record g08 leftover-join.v5 as G08 leftover remasurement', commit e4b20dd, ADOPTED 2026-08-24, dual CONSENT 0/0) recorded g08 leftover-join.v5 as the G08 leftover remasurement. g08 leftover-join.v4 has not been the current G08 GATE leftover-join since D-281, which is 27 recorded headings behind live HEAD D-308.
mustFix.notRescuedByD294: D-294 Decision 1 reads a present-tense cross-lineage currency sentence as custody at the citing join's OWN recording heading — 'it records which sibling was current when the join was recorded'. That convention exonerates the identical sentence in frozen signed-index leftover-join.v4, whose recording heading D-280 precedes D-281; D-294's measured-at-draft-time table lists exactly that pair ('signed-index leftover-join.v4 → g08 leftover-join.v4') and holds it needs no successor under trigger (b). The convention does not license a NEW join to record false custody at its own recording heading. signed-index leftover-join.v5 is recorded after D-281, so under D-294's own reading this sentence asserts that g08 leftover-join.v4 was current at v5's recording. That is false.
mustFix.internalContradiction: The subject contradicts itself on the same slot. purpose: 'Cite g08 leftover-join.v5 (D-281) as the current G08 GATE leftover-join.' registerRowNote: 'g08 leftover-join.v5 remains the current G08 GATE leftover-join (D-281; registerRow DR-G08).' basedOn.g08LeftoverJoinV5.role: 'Current G08 GATE leftover-join (D-281).' basedOn.d259.role: 'g08 leftover-join.v4 is not current after D-281.' Only obligations[3] says v4. A reader cannot determine which of the two mutually exclusive currency claims is operative, and the one that is wrong sits at the site where OBL-G08-FX-AUTHORING — one of the two leftoverDesign obligations — is justified.
mustFix.carriedVerbatim: obligations[3].reason is byte-identical to frozen signed-index leftover-join.v4's obligations[3].reason. The sentence was true at D-280 and was not remasured for this successor.
mustFix.promptAttackLanded: g08 leftover-join.v4 treated as current at live HEAD
mustFix.remedy: At obligations[3], cite g08 leftover-join.v5 (D-281) as the current G08 GATE leftover-join carrying leftoverDesign [OBL-G08-FX-AUTHORING], and record g08 leftover-join.v4 (D-259) as the predecessor that is not current after D-281 — the framing basedOn.d259.role already uses. Do not flip leftoverDesign and do not steal OBL-G08-FX-AUTHORING as a GATE closure.

mustFix.title: The obligation that grounds the harness-spec determination still cites superseded G08 occupancy v3 as the specification and never names G08 occupancy v7, defeating the stated purpose of the remasurement.
mustFix.quotedBytes: G08 is named (D-086) and occupancy remasurement v3 exists at harness.DR-G08.trust-recovery.install-surfaces.v3 (D-211; dual ACCEPT 0/0; CANDIDATE-NOT-APPLIED; not QUALIFIED). Leftover-design of authoring that specification is therefore stale as an authoring claim.
mustFix.why: 'that specification' resolves to G08 occupancy v3. G08 occupancy v7 (harness.DR-G08.trust-recovery.install-surfaces.v7.json, ce1db6b7…, dual ACCEPT 0/0) is the current occupancy remasurement of this same C1-a act. The token 'v7' does not occur anywhere in obligations[1]. The one obligation whose leftoverDesign=false determination rests on an occupancy specification rests it on the superseded one.
mustFix.contradictsOwnPurpose: purpose states, as a commitment of this successor: 'Cite G08 occupancy v7 as the current G08 occupancy remasurement.' leftoverDesignOpenStanding correctly executes it: 'leftover-design of an unauthored G08 specification is stale as an authoring claim after G08 occupancy v7.' obligations[1] does not. The standing field grounds the claim on v7 while the obligation grounding the same claim cites v3.
mustFix.staleOnArrival: D-294 Decision 2 trigger (a) is mechanical and carries no status-token exception: a recorded leftover-join needs a successor when 'an occupancy it cites as the specification is superseded'. Trigger (a) is precisely why signed-index leftover-join.v4 required this successor. Because obligations[1] still cites occupancy v3 as the specification, recording signed-index leftover-join.v5 as drafted would immediately re-fire trigger (a) against it. The successor authored to cure occupancy-staleness reproduces it.
mustFix.divergesFromLiveHeadStandard: distribution-core leftover-join.v10, recorded at D-308 — the last heading, and live HEAD 5cf407a — sets the standard for this exact obligation shape. Its OBL-2 reads: 'Independently reviewed G01-G05 occupancy remasurements now exist: G01 occupancy v11 (D-305), G02 occupancy v6 (D-306), G03 occupancy v5 (D-233), G04 occupancy v5 (D-307), G05 occupancy v4 (D-235) … Frozen G01 occupancy v9 (D-231), G02 occupancy v4 (D-232), and G04 occupancy v4 (D-234) are not current after D-305 through D-307.' It cites the current occupancies and names the superseded ones as not current, in the obligation itself. obligations[1] does neither.
mustFix.carriedVerbatim: obligations[1].reason is byte-identical to frozen signed-index leftover-join.v4's obligations[1].reason.
mustFix.notClaimed: This finding is not the prompt's 'G08 occupancy v3 treated as current' attack in its literal form: obligations[1] says occupancy v3 'exists', not that it is current, and that existence claim is byte-true — v3 is unmoved at 13076be2…. The defect is that the superseded occupancy is cited as the operative specification while the current one is absent.
mustFix.remedy: At obligations[1], cite G08 occupancy v7 (dual ACCEPT 0/0, CANDIDATE-NOT-APPLIED, not QUALIFIED) as the current occupancy remasurement carrying the specification, and record G08 occupancy v3 (D-211) as not current after G08 occupancy v7 — matching basedOn.occupancyV3.role, which already says so. Keep OBL-G08-HARNESS-SPEC leftoverDesign false; the closure is not reopened.

shouldFix.title: The honesty roster omits CLAUDE-V13-M1 and CLAUDE-V13-S1, the findings the consumed law signed-index-trust-contract.v14 lands.
shouldFix.quotedBytes: D-105 records advisories CLAUDE-V8-A1 (ADV-V8-01) and CODEX-V8-A1 (SITCV8-A1) travel as honesty work; they are distinct findings. Honesty work is not leftover-design and is not SATISFIED. This join does not discharge them.
shouldFix.why: OBL-ADVISORY-HONESTY is the bucket for advisory and honesty work travelling on DR-112. This join consumes signed-index-trust-contract.v14 as the current law. v14's own bytes record that it 'lands CLAUDE-V13-M1 and CLAUDE-V13-S1', the Claude MUST-FIX and SHOULD-FIX raised on signed-index-trust-contract.v13. Those two identifiers do not occur anywhere in the subject. The roster enumerates only the D-105-era v8 advisories.
shouldFix.carriedVerbatim: obligations[8].reason is byte-identical to frozen signed-index leftover-join.v4's. v4 was recorded at D-280, before signed-index-trust-contract.v14 existed, so v5 is the first join in this lineage that could carry them, and it does not.
shouldFix.gradedShouldFix: Graded SHOULD-FIX rather than MUST-FIX: nothing asserted in obligations[8] is false, and the v8 advisories it names are correctly labelled and correctly held undischarged. The defect is an incomplete roster relative to the law the join consumes, not a false statement.
shouldFix.remedy: Name CLAUDE-V13-M1 and CLAUDE-V13-S1 in obligations[8] as landed by signed-index-trust-contract.v14, keeping them distinct from CLAUDE-V8-A1 / ADV-V8-01 and CODEX-V8-A1 / SITCV8-A1, which remain undischarged honesty work. Do not invent identifiers for the unlabeled observationsNotFindings of G08 occupancy v7 or signed-index-trust-contract.v14.

shouldFix.title: A bare 'leftover-join.v3' carries no lineage stem and collides across two lineages that both carry OBL-G08-HARNESS-SPEC.
shouldFix.quotedBytes: leftover-join.v3 measured OBL-G08-HARNESS-SPEC leftoverDesign false against occupancy v2.
shouldFix.why: The token has no stem before 'leftover-join'. Both candidate lineages exist and both carry an obligation with the id OBL-G08-HARNESS-SPEC at version 3: signed-index leftover-join.v3 (f1fee0cb…, obligation ids include OBL-G08-HARNESS-SPEC) and g08-leftover-join.v3 (obligation ids OBL-G08-HARNESS-SPEC, OBL-G08-NAMED-CATALOG, OBL-G08-INPUT-CORPUS, OBL-G08-FX-AUTHORING, OBL-G08-EXECUTION, OBL-RESERVED-NUMBERS-NOT-STOLEN). The sentence is therefore not resolvable from its own bytes.
shouldFix.selfInflicted: registerRowNote states the guard this sentence breaks: 'signed-index leftover-join and g08 leftover-join are different lineages; their version numbers are unrelated.' D-294 Decision 1 anchors its reading convention on a 'stem immediately before leftover-join' and expressly treats a token that 'carries no lineage stem' as outside the counted class, so the convention does not disambiguate it either.
shouldFix.underlyingClaimIsTrue: The measurement itself is byte-accurate for the signed-index lineage: signed-index leftover-join.v3 carries OBL-G08-HARNESS-SPEC leftoverDesign false with the reason 'the specification now exists at harness.DR-G08.trust-recovery.install-surfaces.v2'. Only the reference is ambiguous.
shouldFix.gradedShouldFix: Graded SHOULD-FIX: the claim is true under the intended reading and the ambiguity is resolvable from context by a reader who already knows the lineage. It is a wording defect, not a false statement.
shouldFix.remedy: Spell it 'signed-index leftover-join.v3'. Every other version token in the subject is already lineage-qualified; this is the only unqualified one.

decisionRule: ACCEPT only at 0 MUST-FIX and 0 SHOULD-FIX. Two MUST-FIX and two SHOULD-FIX survived verification. REJECT.
